project_type: FileForgeWorkbench -- Rust egui/eframe desktop app (ISPF/File-AID-inspired workbench), multi-crate Cargo workspace. SCRM = Screen Collection and Replay Manager vertical.
build_system: Cargo workspace (default-members). Agents compile-verify SCOPED with -p <crate>; owner runs the full cargo gate. Terminal on this machine mangles ';'-chained and complex one-liners -- use the pwsh7 non-interactive wrapper or dedicated tools and verify by effect (read a log / check a file), never trust the reported Exit Code.
test_framework: cargo test (unit + #[cfg(test)] modules); full-shell GUI behaviour uses egui_kittest build_eframe harnesses. pretty_assertions used in ff-scrm tests.
test_command: cargo test -p ff-scrm ; cargo test -p ff-desktop scrm
verification_instructions: Per .kiro/steering/gate-policy.md: on every change run the scoped trio (cargo check -p <crate>; cargo clippy -p <crate> -- -D warnings; cargo fmt -p <crate> -- --check) plus quick scoped tests, reading logs back (terminal-discipline). Do NOT run the whole-workspace cargo test/nextest/gate as an agent -- that is the owner's authoritative run and it wedges this machine's terminal. TDD: write the failing test first (// Validates: Requirement X.Y), then implementation.
build_command_scoped: cargo check -p ff-scrm -p ff-desktop && cargo clippy -p ff-scrm -p ff-desktop -- -D warnings && cargo fmt -p ff-scrm -p ff-desktop -- --check
snapshot_or_generated_files: None for this task. Built-in menus/themes are code-only and NEVER written to disk (CR-CH-021) -- not relevant here.
environment_constraints: Work ONLY in the worktree c:/workspace/apps/FileForgeWorkbench/.worktrees/scrm-2c-capture-lifecycle (branch scrm-2c); relative paths resolve against the parent workspace, so use the worktree-absolute path. Do NOT merge to main and do NOT push -- the owner reviews, runs the full gate, and merges. No source .rs over 400 non-test lines (split by concern); functions ~40 lines; split a test file before ~200 lines. ASCII-only in source and docs (runtime Unicode box-drawing in OUTPUT strings is allowed). Pin any new dependency to an exact version; avoid new deps where ff-scrm/ff-screen-model already cover it.
contribution_requirements: framework-conformance.md: build ON the single command dispatch (ff_command::resolve_target / shell/target_dispatch.rs) -- NO second dispatcher, NO bespoke 'if upper == ...' intercept. wiring-standard.md: communicate state-changing intent, hold UI state in a grouped shell sub-struct (not a new flat WorkbenchShell field). workspace-conformance.md + master-screen-directive: any Workspace Context reports InteriorFocus and ships a first-Tab egui_kittest test (the Save-As and replay-picker are MODAL overlays, not Contexts, so this does not apply to them; the ScrmViewer Context is unchanged and already compliant). save-convention is not in scope (no editable backing-store Context added).
key_patterns: Dialogs are egui::Window/egui::Modal overlays driven by Option/bool shell-state flags, rendered in WorkbenchShell::render_overlays (shell/update_dialogs.rs) with a self.modal_open guard; model on about_dialog::render and the RESET BARE modal. The SCRM command family is handled by handle_capture (shell/commands_scrm.rs) which routes to ScrmSession (scrm_session.rs) and ff-scrm. CAPTURE file ops resolve through resolve_scrm_path(arg, stem, ext) under scrm_dir() = <User_Data_Dir>/screen-collections/ (ff_session::UserDataDir::resolve(None); test override via dir_overrides.scrm). The per-Context ScreenProvider seam (active_screen_capture, shell/screen_provider.rs) already has providers for every Context (C.1-C.3 done). The bare-SNAPSHOT window screenshot is ASYNC (SnapshotState.pending + screenshot_requested resolved on Event::Screenshot in shell/update.rs) -- so a real per-transition picture is not feasible synchronously; record logical model + command metadata reliably and defer the per-transition picture (documented tradeoff). The ScrmViewer stages self.scrm.active_collection().cloned() each frame in render_body.rs.
relevant_files: crates/ff-scrm/src/persist.rs (zip save/load -- serde field round-trips automatically; study, no change)
crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/dispatch.rs + shell/target_dispatch.rs (single dispatch seam -- stash last_dispatched command+target kind)
crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/state_groups.rs (ADD grouped ScrmUiState + last_dispatched; model on SnapshotState/FocusState)
crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/update_dialogs.rs (render_overlays -- add Save-As + picker guarded blocks; study RESET BARE/about blocks)
crates/ff-desktop/src/about_dialog.rs (dialog render pattern to model on)
.agents/tasks/scrm-2c-capture-lifecycle/plan.md (the ordered plan + Digest this decomposition came from)
directory_structure: crates/ff-scrm/src: GUI-free SCRM engine (model/persist/replay/export/pdf/evidence/rules). crates/ff-screen-model/src: GUI-free screen model + renderers. crates/ff-desktop/src: the egui binary; shell/ holds WorkbenchShell (split across commands_*.rs, render_*.rs, update_*.rs, state*.rs); top-level *_dialog.rs / *_panel.rs are Context/dialog modules. crates/ff-session: UserDataDir domain-path authority. .agents/tasks/scrm-2c-capture-lifecycle holds this task's plan + FEAT artifacts (outside the worktree).
